title: legousia arvensis
intro: Legousia arvensis, commonly known as Corn Salad, is a perennial plant species belonging to the borage family. The leaves of Legousia arvensis are edible and rich in nutrients, offering various health benefits such as high antioxidant activity, anti-inflammatory properties, and potential anti-cancer effects. Its therapeutic actions include anti-diabetic, anti-obesity, and anti-hypertensive effects, as well as the ability to support immune system function. The bioactive constituents of Legousia arvensis include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
